meta.title: Rafshan Ekhowan — Systems & Photography
meta.description: Rafshan Ekhowan — IPTSP, Network & Systems Engineer, and photographer across street, landscape, product and abstract work.

hero.subtitle: I'm Rafshan — a Network & Systems Executive and photographer. Same instinct either way: read the structure before everyone else sees it.

profile.sectionNote: Executive, Network & System Solution at BRACNet. B.Sc. in Information & Communication Engineering.
profile.lead: Network & System Administration professional managing enterprise network and server infrastructure, Linux systems, virtualization, and IPTSP operations.
paragraphs: Experienced in Proxmox virtualization, network and server monitoring, infrastructure troubleshooting, security, backup, and resource optimization — with a strong record of maintaining high availability across production environments.

Proven ability to identify and resolve technical issues, improve operational reliability, and support secure, efficient IT infrastructure — the same eye for what's about to break (or what's about to happen) that shows up in the photography.

education.desc: Studied networking, systems, and communication engineering.

experience.sectionNote: Roles spanning from IPTSP intern to Executive, managing enterprise network infrastructure at BRACNet.

projects.sectionNote: Infrastructure, automation and telephony systems engineered and deployed in production.

items.name: IP PBX & Call Center System
items.description: Deployed and administered an Asterisk-based IP PBX platform with automated call routing, ACD queues, and CDR analytics.
items.longDescription: Comprehensive production deployment of an Asterisk-based IP PBX platform (Issabel). Configured high-capacity SIP trunks, interactive voice response (IVR) flows, automated call distribution (ACD) queues for support teams, and real-time CDR analytics for operational monitoring.

items.name: AI Voice Agent
items.description: Built a voice-based AI customer support agent using Ollama, Python, and Asterisk for automated real-time dialogue.
items.longDescription: Integrated local open-source LLMs via Ollama with Asterisk PBX using custom Python AGI (Asterisk Gateway Interface) scripts. Features low-latency speech-to-text (Whisper), prompt-orchestrated dialogue management, and realistic text-to-speech synthesis with sub-300ms turnaround.

items.name: IPPLAN Vault
items.description: Enhanced a network IP address management system with dynamic SVG topology diagrams and an AES-256 password vault.
items.longDescription: Extended the IPPLAN infrastructure management platform with an integrated credential keystore encrypted via AES-256-CBC. Developed automated SVG network topology visualizers and role-based access control for sysadmin teams across multiple data centers.

items.name: Centralized NTP Server
items.description: Deployed a high-precision Stratum NTP server ensuring strict microsecond clock synchronization across the infrastructure.
items.longDescription: Configured local Stratum 2 NTP time servers utilizing Chrony daemon on hardened Linux hosts. Maintained synchronized timestamping across Proxmox VM clusters, VoIP switches, and security loggers, eliminating drift and timestamp discrepancies.

items.name: TrueNAS Secure Storage Array
items.description: Configured a TrueNAS ZFS storage cluster with TLS-encrypted FTP and automated hourly snapshot replication.
items.longDescription: Engineered enterprise-grade storage using TrueNAS CORE with RAID-Z2 pool redundancy. Implemented automated ZFS snapshot schedules, off-site replication pipelines, and secure FTP over TLS (FTPS) with isolated user chroot environments.
